# Best noise-cancelling headphones under $200

I can't see live prices or checkout pages, so check the current price before you buy. Only one product below has a direct purchase link in my results. For the others, the review pages link to retailers such as Amazon, Best Buy and Walmart.

## Top picks

**Best overall value: Anker Soundcore Space Q45** (about $100)
- RTINGS names it the best headphones under $200 and the best budget ANC pair. It has "amazing" noise isolation, quieting engine rumble and street noise, and about 28 hours of battery with ANC on.
- Downsides: a noticeable hiss with ANC on, and some owners report cracked headbands or hinges.
- [RTINGS review with retailer links](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/budget-noise-cancelling-headphones)

**Best ANC performance: JBL Live 780NC**
- RTINGS' top pick for ANC under $200. It rivals Sony, Bose and Apple flagships, with 60 hours of battery, multipoint, and LDAC.
- Downsides: high clamping force, and it can be uncomfortable on larger heads. RTINGS says it only "sometimes" drops just below $200, so it may cost more at the moment.
- [RTINGS list with retailer links](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/noise-cancelling-headphones-under-200)

**Best long battery and current deal: Soundcore Space One Pro** ($199.99, about $160 with code)
- It has 40 hours of battery with ANC on, LDAC, and a fold-flat design. Tom's Guide lists it as its best under $200, praising the soft ear cups.
- Dealectric tested the code **AFSC20** in Soundcore's cart on 2026-10-22 and it took $39.99 off. It expires 2026-12-31 and doesn't apply to items already on sale. Confirm the final price at checkout.
- Warranty is 18 months, with a 30-day return window. It has no IP rating.
- [Buy at Soundcore's US store (via Dealectric, an affiliate link)](https://dealectric.com/go/soundcore-space-one-pro)
- The newer Space 2 Pro is the same price with Bluetooth 6.1, but only 30 hours of battery with ANC on.

**Best sound: Sennheiser Accentum Plus**
- It has a smooth, bass-forward tuning and a parametric EQ in the app, plus 56 hours of battery. Its ANC is weaker than the Q45's, especially on low rumble like plane engines.
- aptX Adaptive isn't supported natively on Apple devices.
- [RTINGS review with retailer links](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/by-price/under-200)

**Best for calls: Sony ULT WEAR** (about $200)
- SoundGuys measured more than 25 dB of attenuation above 80 Hz, plus multipoint, LDAC, and 32.5 hours of battery.
- [RTINGS list with retailer links](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/noise-cancelling-headphones-under-200)

## Cheaper options
- **JLab JBuds Lux ANC** (about $80): up to 44 hours of battery, but the weakest ANC of the group (10 to 20 dB below 700 Hz). It's fine for buses and offices, not planes. [Source](https://ratingmobile.com/articles/en/best-noise-cancelling-headphones-under-200)
- **Sony WH-CH730N** (about $176 to $178): effective ANC, a comfortable fit, and long battery life. Tom's Guide thinks the U.S. price is high for what you get. [Tom's Guide review](https://www.tomsguide.com/audio/headphones/sony-wh-ch730n-review)

## Which should you get?
- **Strongest ANC:** JBL Live 780NC, or the Sony ULT WEAR if you also want a better mic.
- **Cheapest good ANC:** Soundcore Space Q45.
- **Long flights and battery:** Soundcore Space One Pro, with the code.
- **Sound quality:** Sennheiser Accentum Plus.

If you tell me whether you use an iPhone or Android, and whether you'll mostly use them for flights, commuting or the office, I can narrow it to one.
